Police: Then listen to me, okay? You can try to recall carefully.
Police: At that time, did you see anyone nearby whom you hadn’t seen before? I heard that you were all at the amusement park.
Police: Mom, Xiyuan, and Minghao, right?
Respondent: ...Mm... yes.
Respondent: We... were all together.
